name: KRX-Bench_data
description: KRX-Bench_data is a Hugging Face dataset collection intended for benchmarking tasks related to KRX (likely Korea Exchange) data, combining textual and structured market information for modeling tasks such as classification and regression. It is typically used to evaluate models on financial/news-to-event prediction, time-series inference, or information extraction tasks tied to market instruments.
evaluation_method: accuracy for classification tasks and RMSE/MAPE for regression; task-specific metrics (e.g., precision/recall) for extraction
reputation: A niche dataset on Hugging Face with limited but growing usage among researchers working on Korea-focused financial NLP and time-series tasks.
